VBT dhāraṇās, ānāpānasati, Ajahn Lee — voice cues, timed steps, audio tones
VBT practices: each one has a voice introduction, timed steps, and optional audio cues. Voice cues speak via browser TTS. Silent cues leave space.

VBT Dhāraṇās (interactive)

The body as awareness · VBT v. 63 3 min · 2 steps
narrated
Verse 63 of the Vijñāna Bhairava, in Satsang’s words: rest attention on the whole body at once, the whole field of sensation, then take the body and the world around it as made of awareness; when the
1. Rest attention on the whole body at once: the whole field of sensation, not one part.
2. Take the body and the world around it as made of awareness; felt rather than thought. When the mind
Spaciousness · VBT vv. 43–48 3 min · 4 steps
narrated
The spaciousness dhāraṇās of the Vijñāna Bhairava, in Satsang’s words: notice the space of the room, then the space inside the chest, mouth and skull, feel the skin as a thin wall with open space on b
1. Notice the space of the room around you, holding the walls and your body.
2. Sense the space inside the body: the chest, the mouth, the skull.
3. Feel the skin as a thin wall, open space within and without.
+1 more steps…
Trace the Sound 2.7 min · 5 steps
steps only
A two-minute play. Pick any sound, follow it inward and let it fade on its own. When the line goes flat, rest in what is left. The voice speaks, then stops: the pause is the practice. Repeat it throug
1. Pick a sound that is already here: the room, a fan, traffic, your own breath.
2. Follow it inward until it is only a vibration, not a thing out there.
3. Let it fade the way sounds fade. You are not making it stop.
+2 more steps…

112 Dharana Map

The path: You don't do all 112. Find the upaya that matches your grace level, pick 2-3 dharanas, master them. When they stop working (the technique becomes the obstacle), move to a higher upaya. — Swami Lakshmanjoo
